parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to read, counted from 1.

parameters.name: actorType
parameters.description: Only events by this actor type.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Only events with this action name.

parameters.name: resourceType
parameters.description: Only events about this resource type.

parameters.name: occurredFrom
parameters.description: Only events at or after this instant. ISO-8601 with seconds and an offset or `Z`; other forms are refused rather than guessed at.

parameters.name: occurredTo
parameters.description: Only events at or before this instant; must not precede `occurredFrom`.
